Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: in-game category card illustration for BLOODSHIFT. Create ONE standalone PORTRAIT image, 2:3 aspect ratio, ideally 1024x1536. Use the latest clean cartoon BLOODSHIFT capsule in the conversation as the STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only, not its landscape composition or logo.
Matched set art direction: clean hand-drawn cartoon fantasy, confident bold black contours, large simple shapes, flat matte fills, one cel-shadow tone, very restrained highlights. Limited palette of dark teal, near-black, ivory, crimson, violet and flat antique gold. Quiet layered shrine silhouettes in the background. NO grain, scratches, stippling, brush noise, tiny ornamental detail, realistic rendering, 3D gloss, photographic skin or complex gradients. Readable at 200 pixels wide.
Full-bleed opaque art, NO frame/border, NO words, NO letters, NO logos, NO category label. The game adds its own frame and label. Leave the BOTTOM 18% as a quiet very dark near-black/teal area for a white UI label, with no important features there. Keep subjects and faces within the central 80% of width and upper 75% of height; allow safe margin for frame crop. Cohesive with the other three cards. Strong focal subject, minimal background clutter.
Subject: the game's RED SAMURAI, shown alone in a heroic waist-up three-quarter portrait, facing slightly left. Stern adult male with spiky black hair with crimson streaks, red eyes, uncovered face, open black-and-crimson wrap top, visible red flame chest marking, bold asymmetric red shoulder armor edged antique gold, thick ivory-white fur collar, crimson rope belt. Preserve his identity from the approved capsule. Arms rest naturally with hands outside the visible portrait area; no fighting gesture and no weapon. His face and red armor fill the upper-middle card. Background: a simple muted crimson sun disk behind his head, dark teal shrine roof and a few black cedar silhouettes. Two red maple leaves at most. Red character accents dominate, clean shapes and restrained contrast in the background.
